question: Can frozen identified native knowledge and separately marked provisional hypotheses be bound to the correct source and used together, retaining established knowledge and improving offline action-choice utility?
scope: NO new optimizer, training rule, budget, gate, split or hypothesis selection. CKAD09 greedy failure remains STOPPED and immutable. New work is source-bound opt-in research readout plus a NEW offline decision task on existing known fixtures. This is not new unfamiliar-world scientific evidence, controller or environmental action.

inputs.base: 3 committed CKAD08 full16-address native checkpoints; exact hashes in CKAD08/result.json
inputs.priors: ALL12 frozen CKAD09 REAL512 hypotheses, including6 failed fits. Selection uses frozen exposure/condition only, never held score.128/SHUFFLED source models used only source-binding negative tests as appropriate.
inputs.observations: same512 source consequences/address,24576 across48 source fixtures; no new source world/record scan or original step
inputs.truth: unchanged CKAD02 dataset512 train+1536 held covers all2048 input/action pairs; used ONLY by evaluator, not bundle/choice. Previously consumed and inspected, exploratory engineering/application evidence only.

implementation.method: Immutable bundle of existing NativeContextQuarantine plus optional16 NativePriorHypothesis objects. with_prior validates pinned checkpoint, same context width/observation count, nonquarantined target; reconstructs canonical isolated source view from ACTUALLY observed native values and requires exact match to hypothesis source-view SHA. Recompute saved fit/calibration errors from retained values without retraining. No cross-address source substitution. Existing modules/checkpoints unchanged.
implementation.precedence: Identified native answer ALWAYS wins. Only otherwise consult bound prior; prediction explicitly PROVISIONAL_HYPOTHESIS. Else UNKNOWN. Every response carries status; no bare promotion of provisional answer to known consequence.
implementation.admission: engineering_fixture_only; accepted_native=false,scientific_pass=false; no original/historical causal-mode admission. No overwrite of an already bound different prior, exact replay idempotent.
implementation.cold: Strict canonical bundle checkpoint with pinned native knowledge and all bound parameter checkpoints; restore revalidates source bindings and existing schemas. Native base bytes and all existing predictions retained. Max16 native/16 prior slots,12MiB bundle.
implementation.no_execution: Readout only; offline scorer is a pure comparison. No environment owner callback, actor, source do/reset, queue, scheduler, controller, broker, live model or deployment.

evaluation.prediction_questions: all48x2048=98304 readouts, plus same73728 held questions; identified/provisional/unknown counts and correctness separate. No new training metric claimed. Expected held result is derived from frozen stages:64512 correct,0wrong,9216abstain, but independently checked rather than claimed integrated acceptance.
evaluation.retention: Every prior base identified answer and status must remain exact through12 bindings, cold restore and all query readouts. All3 base checkpoints remain byte exact.
evaluation.offline_decisions: all48x1024=49152 contexts, ask predicted consequences of action0 and1. Recommend only if BOTH available and unequal; otherwise NO recommendation (UNKNOWN or TIE distinguished). For fully specified simulated policy-score ONLY, action0 is the fixed default when no recommendation. This does not execute any action.
evaluation.ground_truth: Truth action-sensitive contexts have y0!=y1; correct preference chooses higher true outcome. Report correct/wrong preference, unnecessary recommendations on true ties, missed opportunities, unknown/tied forecasts, realized default-policy reward, best possible reward, regret. Primary unfamiliar subset requires BOTH source input/action pairs absent from original observed-input mask. Keep all-context denominator and action-sensitive denominator explicit.
evaluation.baselines: frozen CKAD08 base-only; source-bound combined readout; fully fitted CART; fixed action0; independent raw-parameter/source-space implementation of same readout precedence and recommendation rule. Independent tied control forbids unique intelligence claim.

conventional_control.why_new_fit: Previous qualified CART512 artifacts retain held-score/prediction hashes but NOT tree parameters or all2048 predictions needed for this NEW paired-action task. One necessary exact-data reconstruction per48 source fixtures, with identical frozen hyperparameters, verifies held outputs/hashes against qualified CKAD06 receipts. This is control reconstruction for new queries, not a new training comparison or retune.

conventional_control.reuse: Persist every reconstructed tree and all2048 prediction hashes/outputs so future new-query checks can reuse controls without fitting again. Independent scalar tree traversal must exactly reproduce sklearn on all2048.

thresholds.engineering_pass: all98304 readouts match independent parameter-math control with exact status; no wrong sources accepted; all original identified answers/base bytes preserved; fresh-process bundle reproduces all98304 values/statuses; all CART reconstructions match original held receipts and independent traversal. Mandatory final root/NKR05+independentG29 bothOS.
thresholds.application_gain: combined minus base >=16 additional correct preference recommendations on true action-sensitive contexts with BOTH actions unobserved; ZERO wrong preference recommendations incombined. Default-policy total realized reward combined minusbase>=8 across49152 contexts. No new source call.
thresholds.strongest_control: record exact rewards/regrets versus CART and independent equally informed composition; independent equality means no unique native advantage. No post-result decision-rule tuning or interval invented from correlated context samples.
thresholds.classification: FROZEN_KNOWLEDGE_APPLICATION_SUPPORTED only if engineering and application gates pass; else APPLICATION_NO_GO. scientific_pass=false regardless, no new learning/transfer claim.
thresholds.repair_policy: Up to3 implementation-only fixes. Do not alter learned weights, cutoff, gate, choice rule, cohort or thresholds after outcomes.
